_comment: Machine-readable form of the known package-redirect table in
when the pre-push `npm ci --dry-run` fails, so the operator gets the fix
without going back to the dossier.
This file is REFERENCE ONLY — migrate.py never rewrites dependencies.
Wiring a redirect is a human decision: publishing a missing
@crt-platform/* version can collide with an unmerged stream (see the
type=direct    -> npm alias in `dependencies`, NOT also in overrides (EOVERRIDE)
type=both      -> dependency alias AND a reference override

npm_major_trap.rule: Regenerate locks with the SYSTEM npm 10.9.8 and validate with plain `npm ci --dry-run`. Locks generated by npm 11/12 omit nested peer entries (@nestjs/platform-express, express 5, ...) that npm 10's `npm ci` demands, so they validate locally and fail in CI with EUSAGE 'Missing: ... from lock file'.

redirects.notes: In ecom-legacy.etl it is ALSO a direct import -> dependency alias plus a "$@ndcmsl/kafka-nest-module" reference override (fixed 2026-07-12, fd97470).
dist-tag `dev` is 0.3.3. `latest` is 0.4.0 = the unmerged GLS pickup-points stream (glsParcelShop) — do NOT publish over it from dev without merging that first.
Not migrated. Stays on ndcmsl; pin via an overrides bump.
